desc: Analyze the problem and derive the combinatorial formula for the sum of f(P) over all permutations.
Design an O(N log N) algorithm using NTT to compute the required coefficients (e_k and g_k) efficiently.
Implement the solution in Python, including NTT convolution, factorial tables, grouping by digit length, and final accumulation.
Verify correctness on the provided sample inputs (N=3, N=390, N=79223).
